candidateSettings: Inherited caller model/settings; exact runtime/model and decoding settings were not separately recorded.

artifactsSanitization: Only the temporary instruction-source path was changed to its repository-relative spelling in these public copies. Scenario hosts are fictitious.

Router established-host case was added but not independently executed in this run.
